families.rack: deliver a hollow tube into the requested bay of a three-bay rack; guide ears; two saddles (TAPOM PD analogue)
families.rebar: thread a bar through 2-4 coaxial stirrup windows; neighbouring window often occupied (TAPOM RA analogue)
families.lathe: carry a bar through a machine door and insert it into a side-facing chuck bore (machine tending)
families.tote: lower a vertically held rod into one cell of a divided kitting tote among neighbouring parts

split_policy: tune any planner parameter on dev only; test is frozen by the SHA-256 hashes in the manifest

task_semantics.validity: no robot-environment, payload-environment, robot self or payload-arm contact; keep-in rules per state
task_semantics.keep_in: payload parts inside a restricted box must lie inside the allowed box (e.g. only the target bay may be entered)
task_semantics.portals: a payload reference point crosses each declared opening, inside its rectangle, in order
task_semantics.goal: payload pose region around the nominal goal (10-12 mm, 5 deg); q_goal_reference is one IK solution
task_semantics.placement: rack only: centreline over both saddles, 2-20 mm pre-release gap

uncertainty.model: T_WO = T_WE @ [Exp_SO3(phi), delta_t] @ T_EO, TCP frame, one fixed draw per execution

evaluation.common_random_numbers: evaluation draws come from rng([evaluation_seed, 0]) and are identical for every method
evaluation.planning_samples: planners may only use rng([evaluation_seed, 1, seed]) via PlanningProblem.planning_errors
evaluation.episode_failure: first payload-environment or payload-arm contact, or any violated task rule
evaluation.interval: Clopper-Pearson per run; bootstrap over tasks for aggregates

planning.budget_note: a 30 s dev smoke run solved few rebar/lathe tasks with RRT-Connect; report a budget sweep {30, 120, 600} if compute allows
planning.robust_variant_semantics: margin / scenario conditions apply to all states except the given start and goal configurations
planning.witness_access: forbidden except for the labelled reference oracle

metrics: collision rate given a valid path
